summary: Every fuzzer now runs in ./dev final with explicit bounds and seeds, and routine commands can no longer rewrite pinned evidence. ./dev animation-fuzz is new; ./dev fuzz-xml gained --output and defaults to .cache/qa/, with failure evidence derived from the report path instead of the fixed artifacts/WO-M2-03/failures directory; shape_fuzz defaults under .cache/qa/. fuzz.yml gained the push trigger the CI policy requires and writes the pinned packet only via an explicit --output. The final-gate test asserts each step's exact bound and seed. ./dev final passes end to end (CTest 80/80, Python 332/332, 457 s). Revision 6 supersedes revision 5 after a failed verifier round; the observed editor-smoke flake is recorded rather than hidden.
